overview_description.description:
Open Motors (formerly OSVehicle) is a YC backed company (W16) based in Palo Alto (CA) focused on providing B2B solutions for custom self-driving vehicles.  

In April 2017 Open Motors (formerly OSVehicle) introduced EDIT, the 1st ready to use Self-Driving EV, modular, open & white label.  It's designed and engineered specifically for services.
Companies like Uber, Lyft, Amazon, UPS, Domino Pizza can customize EDIT specifications (self-driving hardware stack, connected car, code, vehicle range), look (facelift design, use their brand) with faster time to market (half the time) and lower investments (⅙ the cost). 

For extreme customization, since 2015 OSVehicle has been already providing TABBY EVO: a ready-to-use hardware EV platform which enables companies to produce complete custom electric vehicles.  

Open Motors’ platform is the key functional parts of a car - the wheels, chassis, motor, electronics and battery.

Focusing on the 600B USD market of specialty vehicles, Open Motors’ open, modular, electric vehicle platform allows new and existing car manufacturers to develop their own models saving up to two years of R&D and millions of dollars in investments. At the same time it is a reference platform for mobility startups to embed and develop their technology on, without having to re-invent the wheel or partner with existing car brands and wait years before deploying their products.

product.name: TABBY EVO
product.description: A modular electric vehicle platform designed for research and development, compliant with L7e and M1 vehicle categories, supporting 2 or 4 seat configurations with 15kW or 19kW motors.

product.name: R&D Services
product.description: Engineering, design, robotics, and advanced manufacturing services to develop and scale electric vehicles from concept to mass production.

product.name: EDIT EV Platform
product.description: An electric vehicle platform optimized for cost efficiency and total cost of ownership, designed for Mobility-as-a-Service and logistics applications with modular and upgradeable components.

product.name: HyperSwap Battery Swap System
product.description: An automated electric vehicle battery swapping solution compatible with multiple standards, offering faster and more affordable battery replacement.

identifier.value: Comprehensive EV Production and Supply Chain Solutions

product.name: Comprehensive EV Production and Supply Chain Solutions
product.description: Manufacturing and supply chain management services providing access to global production facilities with scalable capacity for electric vehicle assembly and delivery.

product.name: Energy Solutions and Battery Management
product.description: Development and integration of energy storage, battery swap adaptation, and battery management systems to optimize electric vehicle power and grid interaction.
